subject: doc
title: DOC.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in CMOA(I)-3 (Creative Music Outside of America — Britain, Germany, Holland — Level One), on the page where Braxton argues that 'Europe has always viewed the composite continuity of black creativity as a signal related to the progressional greater dynamics of black culture and world change' — Europe remembering Africa and the transformation that put her in power, in contrast to America's amnesia. (C)DOC (the concept of documentation) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what documentation produces when crossed with progressional-continuance in the European reception of black creativity. IST-F-ACT (isolated focus activism) and P-FC (particular focus) feed the subject from below-left. POL-DY (political dynamics) and (R)OBS (the reality of observation) are upper-right outputs. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is a central convergence. LK-IMP (linkage implications), INFO-COMP (information compression), (R)INT (the reality of intention), and INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) constitute the right output cluster. (DT)OP-SPD (option spread, with the (dt) prefix marking it as 'determines the ___ of its ___' — Braxton's prefix for terms functioning as determining relations rather than ordinary nodes) is the structural endpoint. Structural argument: the diagrammatic use of (dt)op-spd as endpoint registers Braxton's claim that European documentation of black creativity, when crossed with progressional-continuance, *determines* the option-spread available to subsequent reception — a determining-relation, not a passive output.
